description: Header file defining wrapper classes for Metal's command buffer, encoder, and queue objects used in rendering with Metal API, including classes for command queue, command buffer, command encoder, render, blit, and compute encoders.

classes.name: CommandQueue
classes.description: Manages Metal command queue, handles command buffer creation, resource synchronization, and queue management.

classes.name: CommandBuffer
classes.description: Represents a Metal command buffer, manages encoding and submission of GPU commands.

classes.name: CommandEncoder
classes.description: Base class for Metal command encoders, manages encoding GPU commands.

classes.name: RenderCommandEncoder
classes.description: Encodes rendering commands for a render pass.

classes.name: BlitCommandEncoder
classes.description: Encodes commands for copying and synchronizing resources.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the Metal command queue object.

methods.name: finishAllCommands
methods.description: Ensures all commands in the queue are completed.

methods.name: ensureResourceReadyForCPU
methods.description: Waits until the resource is no longer used by GPU.

methods.name: isResourceBeingUsedByGPU
methods.description: Checks if a resource is currently used by GPU.

methods.name: makeMetalCommandBuffer
methods.description: Creates a new Metal command buffer.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits the command buffer for execution.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Presents a drawable to the screen.

methods.name: setWriteDependency
methods.description: Sets a resource dependency for writing.

methods.name: setReadDependency
methods.description: Sets a resource dependency for reading.

methods.name: setActiveCommandEncoder
methods.description: Sets the current active command encoder.

methods.name: invalidateActiveCommandEncoder
methods.description: Invalidates the current active command encoder.

methods.name: endEncoding
methods.description: Ends encoding for the command encoder.

methods.name: setFrontFacingWinding
methods.description: Sets the front face winding order.

methods.name: setStencilRefVal
methods.description: Sets a single stencil reference value.

methods.name: setVertexData
methods.description: Template method to set vertex data.

methods.name: setFragmentData
methods.description: Template method to set fragment data.

methods.name: drawIndexedInstancedBaseVertex
methods.description: Draws indexed instanced primitives with base vertex.

methods.name: setColorStoreAction
methods.description: Sets store action for color attachments.

methods.name: setDepthStencilStoreAction
methods.description: Sets store actions for depth and stencil.

methods.name: renderPassDesc
methods.description: Returns the current render pass description.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the underlying Metal command encoder object.

methods.name: initWriteDependencyAndStoreAction
methods.description: Initializes write dependencies and store actions for textures.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Template method to set data bytes.
